scenario: A Shopify store operations manager queries inventory levels for slow-moving SKUs using clawpify, feeds the stock quantities to financial-calculator to determine markdown percentages based on overstocking thresholds, then uses reporting to produce a promotional pricing report recommending which products to discount and by how much for a clearance campaign.
info_flow: clawpify queries Shopify inventory levels for target SKUs and returns available stock counts → financial-calculator uses those counts against reorder-point thresholds to compute recommended markdown percentages for overstocked items → reporting assembles a clearance promotion plan with SKU, current stock, and recommended discount percentages.
